# NxtWeave Solutions

> NxtWeave Solutions is a premier corporate advisory and digital engineering platform based in Noida, India. We empower startups, MSMEs, NGOs, and global enterprises by weaving legal entity registration, corporate tax compliance, and modern digital web architecture into a single unified launchpad.

## Core Capabilities & Offerings

### Business Registration & Corporate Legal Entity Structuring
- Private Limited Company (Pvt Ltd) Registration: SPICe+ MCA filing, DIN allocation, DSC Class 3, PAN/TAN issuance, MoA/AoA drafting, and INC-20A Commencement of Business.
- Limited Liability Partnership (LLP) Registration: FiLLiP MCA filing, Form 3 LLP agreement execution, DPIN allocation.
- One Person Company (OPC) Registration: Solo founder incorporation under Companies Act 2013 with nominee consent.
- Section 8 Company Registration: Non-profit corporate formation for social and charitable missions.
- Partnership Firm Registration: Partnership deed drafting and Registrar of Firms state registration.

### Certifications, Licensing & Statutory Tax Compliance
- Goods & Services Tax (GST): Mandatory threshold registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B filings, ITC reconciliation.
- MSME / Udyam Registration: Government credit schemes, interest rate subsidies, delayed payment protection under MSME Samadhaan.
- ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management Systems: Audit readiness, QMS manual drafting, stage 1 & 2 external audit compliance.
- Trademark Registration & IP Protection: Trade Marks Act 1999 filing under Nice Classification (Classes 1-45), TM-A filing, hearing representations.
- NGO Accreditations: NGO Darpan (NITI Aayog), 12A income tax exemption, 80G donor deduction, Form CSR-1 filing.
- Trade Licences: Shop Act / Gumasta license, FSSAI food licensing, Import-Export Code (IEC), Startup India DPIIT recognition.

### Digital Software & Web Architecture
- High-Performance Web Development: Modern Next.js and React web portals optimized for 100/100 Lighthouse performance.
- Scalable Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, Firebase Data Connect, and multi-tenant cloud backends.
- Custom Business CRM & Admin Dashboards: Real-time analytics, automated lead workflows, and customer management.

### Growth Marketing & Paid Performance
- Performance Marketing: Meta Ads Manager Advantage+ campaigns, Conversion API (CAPI), and Google Search PPC.
- B2B Lead Generation: High-deliverability cold email campaigns, SPF/DKIM/DMARC domain warm-ups, and sales funnels.
